reddit.title: Improving Flowing Water Performance in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the performance of flowing lakes in Provincia! By optimizing how we handle drying cells, we've reduced the script time for a 64x64 lake from about 20 ms to just 12 ms. This means smoother gameplay and less frame hitching. Check out the full details of these changes here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

posts: Exciting news for Provincia players! We've cut down the processing time for flowing lakes significantly. Now, drying one cell only refreshes its immediate neighbors instead of rescanning the entire map. This change enhances performance and reduces frame hitches. Read more about it here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
